1	package renderer
2	
3	import (
4		"bytes"
5		"fmt"
6		"strings"
7	
8		gast "github.com/yuin/goldmark/ast"
9		east "github.com/yuin/goldmark/extension/ast"
10	
11		mast "github.com/usememos/memos/internal/markdown/ast"
12	)
13	
14	// MarkdownRenderer renders goldmark AST back to markdown text.
15	type MarkdownRenderer struct {
16		buf *bytes.Buffer
17	}
18	
19	// NewMarkdownRenderer creates a new markdown renderer.
20	func NewMarkdownRenderer() *MarkdownRenderer {
21		return &MarkdownRenderer{
22			buf: &bytes.Buffer{},
23		}
24	}
25	
26	// Render renders the AST node to markdown and returns the result.
27	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) Render(node gast.Node, source []byte) string {
28		r.buf.Reset()
29		r.renderNode(node, source, 0)
30		return r.buf.String()
31	}
32	
33	// renderNode renders a single node and its children.
34	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderNode(node gast.Node, source []byte, depth int) {
35		switch n := node.(type) {
36		case *gast.Document:
37			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
38	
39		case *gast.Paragraph:
40			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
41			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
42				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
43			}
44	
45		case *gast.Text:
46			// Text nodes store their content as segments in the source
47			segment := n.Segment
48			r.buf.Write(segment.Value(source))
49			if n.SoftLineBreak() {
50				r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
51			} else if n.HardLineBreak() {
52				r.buf.WriteString("  \n")
53			}
54	
55		case *gast.CodeSpan:
56			r.buf.WriteByte('`')
57			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
58			r.buf.WriteByte('`')
59	
60		case *gast.Emphasis:
61			symbol := "*"
62			if n.Level == 2 {
63				symbol = "**"
64			}
65			r.buf.WriteString(symbol)
66			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
67			r.buf.WriteString(symbol)
68	
69		case *gast.Link:
70			r.buf.WriteString("[")
71			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
72			r.buf.WriteString("](")
73			r.buf.Write(n.Destination)
74			if len(n.Title) > 0 {
75				r.buf.WriteString(` "`)
76				r.buf.Write(n.Title)
77				r.buf.WriteString(`"`)
78			}
79			r.buf.WriteString(")")
80	
81		case *gast.AutoLink:
82			url := n.URL(source)
83			if n.AutoLinkType == gast.AutoLinkEmail {
84				r.buf.WriteString("<")
85				r.buf.Write(url)
86				r.buf.WriteString(">")
87			} else {
88				r.buf.Write(url)
89			}
90	
91		case *gast.Image:
92			r.buf.WriteString("![")
93			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
94			r.buf.WriteString("](")
95			r.buf.Write(n.Destination)
96			if len(n.Title) > 0 {
97				r.buf.WriteString(` "`)
98				r.buf.Write(n.Title)
99				r.buf.WriteString(`"`)
100			}
101			r.buf.WriteString(")")
102	
103		case *gast.Heading:
104			r.buf.WriteString(strings.Repeat("#", n.Level))
105			r.buf.WriteByte(' ')
106			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
107			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
108				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
109			}
110	
111		case *gast.CodeBlock, *gast.FencedCodeBlock:
112			r.renderCodeBlock(n, source)
113	
114		case *gast.Blockquote:
115			// Render each child line with "> " prefix
116			r.renderBlockquote(n, source, depth)
117			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
118				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
119			}
120	
121		case *gast.List:
122			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
123			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
124				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
125			}
126	
127		case *gast.ListItem:
128			r.renderListItem(n, source, depth)
129	
130		case *gast.ThematicBreak:
131			r.buf.WriteString("---")
132			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
133				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
134			}
135	
136		case *east.Strikethrough:
137			r.buf.WriteString("~~")
138			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
139			r.buf.WriteString("~~")
140	
141		case *east.TaskCheckBox:
142			if n.IsChecked {
143				r.buf.WriteString("[x] ")
144			} else {
145				r.buf.WriteString("[ ] ")
146			}
147	
148		case *east.Table:
149			r.renderTable(n, source)
150			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
151				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
152			}
153	
154		// Custom Memos nodes
155		case *mast.TagNode:
156			r.buf.WriteByte('#')
157			r.buf.Write(n.Tag)
158	
159		case *mast.MentionNode:
160			r.buf.WriteByte('@')
161			r.buf.Write(n.Username)
162	
163		default:
164			// For unknown nodes, try to render children
165			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
166		}
167	}
168	
169	// renderChildren renders all children of a node.
170	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderChildren(node gast.Node, source []byte, depth int) {
171		child := node.FirstChild()
172		for child != nil {
173			r.renderNode(child, source, depth+1)
174			child = child.NextSibling()
175		}
176	}
177	
178	// renderCodeBlock renders a code block.
179	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderCodeBlock(node gast.Node, source []byte) {
180		if fenced, ok := node.(*gast.FencedCodeBlock); ok {
181			// Fenced code block with language
182			r.buf.WriteString("```")
183			if lang := fenced.Language(source); len(lang) > 0 {
184				r.buf.Write(lang)
185			}
186			r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
187	
188			// Write all lines
189			lines := fenced.Lines()
190			for i := 0; i < lines.Len(); i++ {
191				line := lines.At(i)
192				r.buf.Write(line.Value(source))
193			}
194	
195			r.buf.WriteString("```")
196			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
197				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
198			}
199		} else if codeBlock, ok := node.(*gast.CodeBlock); ok {
200			// Indented code block
201			lines := codeBlock.Lines()
202			for i := 0; i < lines.Len(); i++ {
203				line := lines.At(i)
204				r.buf.WriteString("    ")
205				r.buf.Write(line.Value(source))
206			}
207			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
208				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
209			}
210		}
211	}
212	
213	// renderBlockquote renders a blockquote with "> " prefix.
214	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderBlockquote(node *gast.Blockquote, source []byte, depth int) {
215		// Create a temporary buffer for the blockquote content
216		tempBuf := &bytes.Buffer{}
217		tempRenderer := &MarkdownRenderer{buf: tempBuf}
218		tempRenderer.renderChildren(node, source, depth)
219	
220		// Add "> " prefix to each line
221		content := tempBuf.String()
222		lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(content, "\n"), "\n")
223		for i, line := range lines {
224			r.buf.WriteString("> ")
225			r.buf.WriteString(line)
226			if i < len(lines)-1 {
227				r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
228			}
229		}
230	}
231	
232	// renderListItem renders a list item with proper indentation and markers.
233	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderListItem(node *gast.ListItem, source []byte, depth int) {
234		parent := node.Parent()
235		list, ok := parent.(*gast.List)
236		if !ok {
237			r.renderChildren(node, source, depth)
238			return
239		}
240	
241		// Add indentation only for nested lists
242		// Document=0, List=1, ListItem=2 (no indent), nested ListItem=3+ (indent)
243		if depth > 2 {
244			indent := strings.Repeat("  ", depth-2)
245			r.buf.WriteString(indent)
246		}
247	
248		// Add list marker
249		if list.IsOrdered() {
250			fmt.Fprintf(r.buf, "%d. ", list.Start)
251			list.Start++ // Increment for next item
252		} else {
253			r.buf.WriteString("- ")
254		}
255	
256		// Render content
257		r.renderChildren(node, source, depth)
258	
259		// Add newline if there's a next sibling
260		if node.NextSibling() != nil {
261			r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
262		}
263	}
264	
265	// renderTable renders a table in markdown format.
266	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderTable(table *east.Table, source []byte) {
267		// This is a simplified table renderer
268		// A full implementation would need to handle alignment, etc.
269		r.renderChildren(table, source, 0)
270	}

// RunOnce rebuilds the payload of all memos.
func (r *Runner) RunOnce(ctx context.Context) {
	// Process memos in batches to avoid loading all memos into memory at once
	const batchSize = 100
	offset := 0
	processed := 0

	for {
		limit := batchSize
		memos, err := r.Store.ListMemos(ctx, &store.FindMemo{
			Limit:  &limit,
			Offset: &offset,
		})
		if err != nil {
			slog.Error("failed to list memos", "err", err)
			return
		}

		// Break if no more memos
		if len(memos) == 0 {
			break
		}

		// Process batch
		batchSuccessCount := 0
		for _, memo := range memos {
			if err := RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, r.MarkdownService); err != nil {
				slog.Error("failed to rebuild memo payload", "err", err, "memoID", memo.ID)
				continue
			}
			if err := r.Store.UpdateMemo(ctx, &store.UpdateMemo{
				ID:      memo.ID,
				Payload: memo.Payload,
			}); err != nil {
				slog.Error("failed to update memo", "err", err, "memoID", memo.ID)
				continue
			}
			batchSuccessCount++
		}

		processed += len(memos)
		slog.Info("Processed memo batch", "batchSize", len(memos), "successCount", batchSuccessCount, "totalProcessed", processed)

		// Move to next batch
		offset += len(memos)
	}
}

func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	if memo.Payload == nil {
		memo.Payload = &storepb.MemoPayload{}
	}

	// Use goldmark service to extract all metadata in a single pass (more efficient)
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	if err != nil {
		return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to extract markdown metadata")
	}

	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}

272	
273		err = gast.Walk(root, func(n gast.Node, entering bool) (gast.WalkStatus, error) {

277				case gast.KindCodeBlock, gast.KindFencedCodeBlock:
278					return gast.WalkSkipChildren, nil
279				default:
280					// Continue walking for other node types
281				}
282	
283				// Add space before block elements (except first)
284				switch n.Kind() {
285				case gast.KindParagraph, gast.KindHeading, gast.KindListItem, east.KindTableCell, east.KindTableRow, east.KindTableHeader:
286					if buf.Len() > 0 && lastNodeWasBlock {
287						buf.WriteByte(' ')
288					}
289				default:
290					// No space needed for other node types
291				}
292			}
293	
294			if !entering {
295				// Mark that we just exited a block element
296				switch n.Kind() {
297				case gast.KindParagraph, gast.KindHeading, gast.KindListItem, east.KindTableCell, east.KindTableRow, east.KindTableHeader:

307			// Extract text from various node types
308			switch node := n.(type) {
309			case *gast.Text:
310				segment := node.Segment
311				buf.Write(segment.Value(content))
312				if node.SoftLineBreak() {
313					buf.WriteByte(' ')
314				}
315			case *gast.AutoLink:
316				buf.Write(node.URL(content))
317				return gast.WalkSkipChildren, nil
318			case *mast.TagNode:
319				buf.WriteByte('#')
320				buf.Write(node.Tag)
321			default:
322				// Ignore other node types.
323			}
324	
325			// Stop walking if we've exceeded double the max length
326			// (we'll truncate precisely later)
327			if buf.Len() > maxLength*2 {
328				return gast.WalkStop, nil
329			}
330	
331			return gast.WalkContinue, nil
332		})
333	
334		if err != nil {

338		snippet := buf.String()

341		if len(snippet) > maxLength {

// RunOnce rebuilds the payload of all memos.
func (r *Runner) RunOnce(ctx context.Context) {
	// Process memos in batches to avoid loading all memos into memory at once
	const batchSize = 100
	offset := 0
	processed := 0

	for {
		limit := batchSize
		memos, err := r.Store.ListMemos(ctx, &store.FindMemo{
			Limit:  &limit,
			Offset: &offset,
		})
		if err != nil {
			slog.Error("failed to list memos", "err", err)
			return
		}

		// Break if no more memos
		if len(memos) == 0 {
			break
		}

		// Process batch
		batchSuccessCount := 0
		for _, memo := range memos {
			if err := RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, r.MarkdownService); err != nil {
				slog.Error("failed to rebuild memo payload", "err", err, "memoID", memo.ID)
				continue
			}
			if err := r.Store.UpdateMemo(ctx, &store.UpdateMemo{
				ID:      memo.ID,
				Payload: memo.Payload,
			}); err != nil {
				slog.Error("failed to update memo", "err", err, "memoID", memo.ID)
				continue
			}
			batchSuccessCount++
		}

		processed += len(memos)
		slog.Info("Processed memo batch", "batchSize", len(memos), "successCount", batchSuccessCount, "totalProcessed", processed)

		// Move to next batch
		offset += len(memos)
	}
}

func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	if memo.Payload == nil {
		memo.Payload = &storepb.MemoPayload{}
	}

	// Use goldmark service to extract all metadata in a single pass (more efficient)
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	if err != nil {
		return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to extract markdown metadata")
	}

	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}

func NewRunner(store *store.Store, markdownService markdown.Service) *Runner {
	return &Runner{
		Store:           store,

	}
}

// RunOnce rebuilds the payload of all memos.
func (r *Runner) RunOnce(ctx context.Context) {
	// Process memos in batches to avoid loading all memos into memory at once
	const batchSize = 100
	offset := 0
	processed := 0

	for {
		limit := batchSize
		memos, err := r.Store.ListMemos(ctx, &store.FindMemo{
			Limit:  &limit,
			Offset: &offset,
		})
		if err != nil {
			slog.Error("failed to list memos", "err", err)
			return
		}

		// Break if no more memos
		if len(memos) == 0 {
			break
		}

		// Process batch
		batchSuccessCount := 0
		for _, memo := range memos {
			if err := RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, r.MarkdownService); err != nil {
				slog.Error("failed to rebuild memo payload", "err", err, "memoID", memo.ID)
				continue
			}
			if err := r.Store.UpdateMemo(ctx, &store.UpdateMemo{
				ID:      memo.ID,
				Payload: memo.Payload,
			}); err != nil {
				slog.Error("failed to update memo", "err", err, "memoID", memo.ID)
				continue
			}
			batchSuccessCount++
		}

		processed += len(memos)
		slog.Info("Processed memo batch", "batchSize", len(memos), "successCount", batchSuccessCount, "totalProcessed", processed)

		// Move to next batch
		offset += len(memos)
	}
}

func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	if memo.Payload == nil {
		memo.Payload = &storepb.MemoPayload{}
	}

	// Use goldmark service to extract all metadata in a single pass (more efficient)
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	if err != nil {
		return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to extract markdown metadata")
	}

	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}

h13.

The `markdown.Service` interface (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55`) is Memos' abstraction for markdown parsing/rendering/extraction.

**Implementation** — `service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:58-60`), an unexported struct wrapping a `goldmark.Markdown` instance (goldmark + `extension.GFM`, plus optional custom `extensions.TagExtension`/`extensions.MentionExtension`). It's the only concrete type implementing `Service`. (Its `RenderMarkdown`/`RenameTag` methods internally use a second, unexported helper type, `renderer.MarkdownRenderer` in `internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go`, to serialize the goldmark AST back to markdown text — but that type isn't itself an implementer of `Service`; it's a component `service` composes.)

**Construction** — via `markdown.NewService(...)` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`):
- `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48` — in `NewAPIV1Service`, with `WithTagExtension()` + `WithMentionExtension()` (the production instance).
- `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44` — same options, for tests.
- Also directly in `rss_test.go` and `fileserver_test.go` for test setups.

**Holders of the interface** (fields typed `markdown.Service`, not the concrete type):
- `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35` (the source of the runtime instance; used e.g. in `memo_mention_helpers.go:32`, `memo_service_webhooks.go:85`, and passed into `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` from `memo_service.go:108,447`)
- `RSSService.MarkdownService` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:45` (constructed in `NewRSSService`, called from `server/server.go:85` with `apiV1Service.MarkdownService`, i.e. the same singleton instance is reused, not a new one)
- `Runner.MarkdownService` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16` (via `memopayload.NewRunner`); note this `Runner`/`NewRunner` isn't wired up anywhere in `server.go` — only the free function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, markdownService)` is actually called in production code, taking the interface as a plain parameter rather than through this struct.

So at runtime there is exactly one concrete implementation, `*service` (package `internal/markdown`), constructed once in `NewAPIV1Service` and shared by reference into `RSSService` and passed as a parameter to `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`.
